target_customer: Launch vehicle, orbital transfer vehicle, lunar lander and spacecraft operators that need in orbit fuel
problem: Spacecraft cannot refuel in orbit, which limits payload and life. Spaceium builds automated stations and the OpenPort interface to store and transfer fuel and repair spacecraft.
business_model: In orbit fuel transfer services and station contracts; OpenPort offered as an open licensed interface
product_category: In orbit refueling and servicing infrastructure

founders.name: Ashi Dissanayake
founders.background_notes: Orbital mechanics and propulsion; led University of Ottawa rocketry team with Fetanat (YC launch post). Education not listed.

founders.name: Reza Fetanat
founders.background_notes: Mechanical engineer in robotics, structures and cryogenics; led a university rocket program and worked on LR-101 engine revival (YC page). Education not listed.

competitors.name: Orbit Fab
competitors.what: Orbital fuel supply with RAFTI refueling port
competitors.traction_then: Shipped first refueling ports to the Space Force and docked a fuel shuttle with a satellite in March 2024

technical_complexity.rationale: Cryogenic and non cryogenic fuel transfer with zero loss, robotic arm and automated stations in orbit require hardware, launch and flight heritage.

defensibility.rationale: Hardware heritage, flight demos and an open port standard it controls are hard to copy quickly, though Orbit Fab and others compete.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move against Spaceium found; it flew a demo actuator on Transporter-15.

market_need_then: Refueling would raise payload and extend life; Spaceium claimed $86.1M in binding contracts and larger pipelines (company claim, unaudited). Space agencies and operators were investing in servicing in 2024.

identity.logo: Brandfetch lists an orange primary logo (Blaze Orange)
identity.visual_style: Space industry look with orange accent
identity.voice_and_tone: Industry infrastructure voice emphasizing openness and a space superhighway

branding.brand_signature: The space superhighway phrase and the trademarked OpenPort
branding.community_and_virality: Press from Payload, SpaceNews and TechCrunch; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear space themed coinage and a memorable superhighway metaphor, but limited public awareness beyond trade press.

outcome_analysis: Spaceium joined YC S24 from Ottawa and raised a $6.3M oversubscribed seed in January 2025 led by Initialized Capital, then flew a demo actuator on SpaceX Transporter-15. It claims large contract backlogs that remain self reported. Hardware risk is high, but demo progress and funding are positive signals. No shutdown or acquisition was found.
notes: Seed confirmed by TechCrunch, Payload and the company law firm release. An aggregator reports $6.8M across two rounds and different investors; unverified. Website lists Nova Threshold as a backer but no article confirmed it. Contract figures are company claims. The seed was after the batch, so the 2024 competitor list uses a single dated source.
